what_for.text: It is used to treat and prevent blood clots in legs and lungs.
what_for.evidence: treat blood clots in the veins of your legs (deep vein thrombosis) and in the blood vessels of your lungs (pulmonary embolism), and to prevent blood clots from re-occurring in the blood vessels of your legs and/or lungs.

how_to_use.text: Always take this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you.
how_to_use.evidence: Always take this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you.

how_to_use.text: If you miss a dose, do not take a double dose to make up for it.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

how_to_use.text: Do not stop taking Xarelto without talking to your doctor first.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not stop taking Xarelto without talking to your doctor first.

see_doctor_now.text: Seek medical care immediately if you have signs of bleeding into the brain.
see_doctor_now.evidence: bleeding into the brain or inside the skull (symptoms can include headache, one-sided weakness, vomiting, seizures, decreased level of consciousness, and neck stiffness. A serious medical emergency. Seek medical attention immediately!)

see_doctor_now.text: Contact your doctor immediately if you take too many Xarelto tablets.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Contact your doctor immediately if you have taken too many Xarelto tablets.

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you notice severe skin rash or blistering.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Tell your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: ... Signs of severe skin reactions ... spreading intense skin rash, blisters or mucosal lesions

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you experience face swelling or breathing difficulties.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Tell your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: ... Signs of severe allergic reactions ... swelling of the face, lips, mouth, tongue or throat; difficulty swallowing; hives and breathing difficulties

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you feel numbness or leg weakness after anaesthesia.
see_doctor_now.evidence: tell your doctor immediately if you get numbness or weakness of your legs or problems with your bowel or bladder after the end of anaesthesia, because urgent care is necessary.

side_effects.text: Common side effects include bleeding in the stomach, bowel, nose, or gums.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... bleeding in the stomach or bowel, urogenital bleeding (including blood in the urine and heavy menstrual bleeding), nose bleed, bleeding in the gum

side_effects.text: Bruising or swelling in the limbs can commonly occur.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... bleeding into tissue or a cavity of the body (haematoma, bruising) ... swelling in the limbs

side_effects.text: You may feel dizzy, weak, or get a headache.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... decreased general strength and energy (weakness, tiredness), headache, dizziness

side_effects.text: It can cause low blood pressure, stomach ache, indigestion, or diarrhoea.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... stomach ache, indigestion, feeling or being sick, constipation, diarrhoea ... low blood pressure (symptoms may be feeling dizzy or fainting when standing up)

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: Do not use this medicine after the expiry date on the carton.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine after the expiry date which is stated on the carton and on each blister or bottle after EXP.

storage.text: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.
storage.evidence: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.

storage.text: Crushed tablets are stable in water or apple puree up to 4 hours.
storage.evidence: Crushed tablets are stable in water or apple puree for up to 4 hours.
